projects.title: Maiver
projects.description: SMS marketing platform with built-in compliance: import a list, build the campaign and follow every send live, with automatic opt-out and visible cost.
details: Spreadsheet-to-send flow in three steps: import list, build campaign, send
Structural opt-out: after STOP, the contact is blocked automatically
Automations such as abandoned-cart recovery
Cost visible for every send, before it goes out
Landing page built with Astro, React components and Tailwind CSS

projects.title: Voga
projects.description: Legal-tech ecosystem with AI for lawyers, born from the experience of Cálculo Jurídico, used by more than 105,000 lawyers.
details: Brings together products such as Cálculo Jurídico, Voga IA, Chat Jurídico, LivrosAdv and Jurídico Viral
Free tools and content for lawyers
Integration between the law firm's systems and processes
Continuous evolution driven by data and real usage

projects.title: Jurídico Viral
projects.description: Social media content platform for lawyers based on Kevin Domingos' method (Judiciário do Caos, 1.4M+ followers): ready-to-post content checked against Brazilian Bar (OAB) rules.
details: Law firm profile setup and content generation with the viral method
Compliance check against OAB advertising rules
App built with React, TypeScript and Vite, Supabase, and Playwright E2E tests
Marketing site and blog built with Jekyll, hosted on Firebase

projects.title: LivrosAdv
projects.description: Platform for lawyers to write their own legal book with AI specialized in Brazilian law, from outline to review.
details: Outline generation and chapter writing with law-specialized AI
Review and validation tools for the manuscript
Publishing as a separate step, at the author's discretion
Legal marketing content by practice area, within OAB rules

projects.title: Foco Valinhos
projects.description: News portal for the city of Valinhos in a social media format: news, opinion and events in a continuous feed, with likes, comments and sharing.
details: Continuous feed organized by section (City, Politics, Culture, Sports and more)
Front end built with TanStack Start, React and Tailwind CSS
Newsroom managed in Payload CMS (Next.js) with PostgreSQL
Hosted on Google Cloud Run, with ad slots and subscriptions

projects.title: Divam
projects.description: Online medical appointment scheduling platform, offering an intuitive experience for patients and healthcare professionals.
details: Modern and responsive interface for appointment scheduling
Real-time notification system
Complete dashboard for medical schedule management
Payment gateway integration
Rating and feedback system

projects.title: Portfolio
projects.description: Personal website and portfolio, developed with modern technologies and focus on performance and accessibility.
details: Responsive and minimalist design
Multi-language support (i18n)
Performance optimization with SSR
Continuous integration with Docker
